list.description: List the capabilities the selected database estate declares, with the user story each one retains.

find.description: Find declared capabilities whose identity or retained meaning matches the query; each result reports the fields that matched.

reveal.description: Reveal a declared capability. --as meaning (default) tells its canonical story from retained authority, --format markdown for review-ready documentation with declared-relationship diagrams; --as circuit reads its retained blueprint.

invoke.description: Execute the database capability's declared root through the candidate memory provider; authority is read and planned per invocation.

observe.description: Execute the database capability exactly as invoke does and tell its story: the declared faces, responsibilities in declared order with testimony timing, composed scenarios, and (with --display) the declared products; the result carries the planned-vs-observed overlay and the observed-path digest. The stream is story-first -- the scenario altitude -- and --trace streams the complete mechanical testimony; --observation-altitude NAME (repeatable: scenario, mechanic, provider, physical) selects which semantic cell altitudes stream, and every selected altitude also streams the edges entering it.

circuit.description: Read a retained circuit catalogue or view from the selected snapshot media publication.

catalogue.description: List the capabilities selected by the current database estate, with retained circuit availability.

project.description: Project the capability's declared authority into executable mechanical bodies: stage its declared documents into --workspace, run the admitted consumer projector per target, and write the carriers, generated bodies, plans, queries and conformance evidence under <workspace>/projected. --targets selects targets (the workspace's declared targets are the default); --full-mechanics selects the per-language capability execution emitters, so each target's plan is realized as target-native code; --codegen-pattern TYPE (repeatable: sequence, selection, broadcast, join, recurrence, return, failure, cancellation, decomposition, for-each) renders the patterns of that type by splicing the registered codegen resolver's emitted code into the generated body instead of calling the runtime resolver, and refuses the projection for a type the target has no codegen registration for. Projection is review/publish output, never the invocation path.

invoke.description: Invoke one objective through the agent lane: the governed model invocation capability supplies a proposal (untrusted testimony), the harness resolves the proposed capability, and either executes it through the same governed delivery or refuses by absence. Supply --objective TEXT, optionally --model NAME (this environment admits gemini); canonical JSON via --input additionally accepts providerAuthorityId, modelAlias, visibleCapabilities, maximumOutputTokens.

artifact.description: Read the original bytes of an artifact in the selected snapshot media publication.
